rows.en:
(Yamashiro-sensei actually remembered
about the return gift...
That alone makes me happy.)

(Today's White Day. I bought a return gift
for Akimizu, but now that it's time
to give it, I'm nervous...)
Give Akimizu a return gift
Don't give Akimizu a return gift
Akimizu, got a minute?
What is it, \p-kun?

Huh?!
...Oh, come to think of it, today's White Day,
isn't it?

Oh, no. I'm happy that you
remembered at all.

Same here,
Akimizu.

(I managed to give the return gift, and
Akimizu was happy with it. I guess
that turned out well.)

(I feel bad for Akimizu, but it's just too
embarrassing. I can't give her the return gift...)

(Today's White Day. I bought a return gift

Give Claire-senpai a return gift

Claire-senpai, do you have a minute?

Did you need something from me,
\p-kun?

Huh?!
...Oh, that's right. Today's White Day,
isn't it?
I'm happy you even remembered.

Hee hee. Let's keep getting along,
\p-kun.

I hope so too,
Claire-senpai.

(I managed to give the return gift, and
Claire-senpai was happy with it. I guess
that turned out well.)

(I feel bad for Claire-senpai, but it's just too
embarrassing. I can't give her the return gift...)

Pinon-chan, got a minute?
...Come to think of it, today's White Day.
No, I'm glad you even remembered.

L-let's keep getting along,
\p.
rows.notes: Pinon's stiff 'yoroshiku onegai suru zo', flustered.

rows.en:

It's White Day, isn't it?
I brought you a proper return gift.

Sorry it's just candy, the usual return gift,
but I'd appreciate it if you'd take it.
Thanks, Saotome-kun.
